title: Skin AI LLM interpretation response
description: The complete structured response returned by the language interpretation call. The backend treats this response as an untrusted proposal and validates it before displaying the reply or matching products.

requestStatus.description: Whether the original user message contains a supported clothing request.

searchReady.description: Whether the backend may run catalogue matching after validating this response.

reply.description: A short contextual response. It must not claim product facts or results that the backend did not supply as trusted context.

requirements.description: A complete replacement for the current normalized requirements, or null when the existing requirements should remain unchanged.
